desc.en: Sayed Ibn Taaoos narrated in his book ‘Mohijj al-Da’waat’ on the authority of Imam Reza (a) that he (a) said: “A person came to Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a) and complained to him about the tyranny inflicted upon him. Imam (a) said to him: Why do you not recite Dua’e Mazloom (Supplication of the Oppressed) which the Messenger (s) had taught to Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (a)? There is not a single aggrieved person who recites this supplication and has not got deliverance from the mischief of the tyrant…
desc.rurdu: Sayed Ibne Taaoos apni kitaab Mohijj al-Da’waat mein Imam Reza (a) se riwaayat karte hai keh Imam (a) ne farmaya: Ek shakhs Imam Jafar Sadiq (a) ke paas aaya aur zaalim ke zulm ki shikaayat karne laga. Imam (a) ne usey farmaya: Tum kyu’n nahin Dua’e Mazloom padhte ho jo Rasool’e Khuda (s) ne Imam Ali (a) ko taaleem di thi? Koi aisa ek sataaya huwa insaan nahin jo is dua ko padhe aur usey zaalim se najaat na mili ho…
desc.urdu: سید ابن طاؤوس اپنی کتاب مہیج الدعوات میں امام رضاؑ سے روایت کرتے ہیں کہ امامؑ نے فرمایا: ایک شخص امام جعفر صادقؑ کے پاس آ کر ظالم کے ظلم کی شکایت کرنے لگا۔ امامؑ نے اسے فرمایا: تم کیوں نہیں دعائے مظلوم پڑھتے ہو جو رسول خداؐ نے امام علیؑ کو تعلیم دی تھی؟ کوئی ایسا ایک ستایا ہوا انسان نہیں جو اس دعا کو پڑھے اور اسے ظالم سے نجات نہ ملی ہو۔۔۔

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ طُـمَّهٗ بِالْبَلَآءِ طَـمًّا وَغُـمَّهٗ بِالْبَلَآءِ غَـمًّا وَقُـمَّهٗ بِالْاَذٰى قَـمًّا وَارْمِهٖ بِيَوْمٍ لَا مَعَادَ لَهٗ وَسَاعَةٍ لَا مَرَدَّ لَهَا وَاَبـِحْ حَرِيْـمَهٗ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُـحَمَّدٍ وَاَهْلِ بَيْتِهٖ (عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ) وَقِنِيْ شَرَّهٗ وَاكْفِنِيْ اَمْرَهٗ وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّيْ كَيْدَهٗ وَاَحْرِجْ قَلْبَهٗ وَسُدَّ فَاهُ عَنِّيْ ’’وَ خَشَعَتِ الْاَصْوَاتُ لِلرَّحْمٰنِ فَلَا تَسْمَعُ اِلَّا هَمْسًا‘‘ ’’وَ عَنَتِ الْوُجُوْهُ لِلْحَيِّ الْقَيُّوْمِ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًا’’ ’’اِخْسَئُوْا فِيْهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُوْنِ‘‘ صَهْ صَهْ صَهْ صَهْ صَهْ صَهْ صَهْ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA TUMMAHU BIL-BALAAA-E TAMMAN WA GHUMMAHU BIL-BALAAA-E GHAMMAN WA QUMMAHU BIL-AZAA QAMMAN WARMEHI BE-YAWMIN LAA MAA’ADA LAHU WA SAA-A’TIN LAA MARADDA LAHAA WA ABEH HAREEMAHU WA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AHLE BAYTEHI (A’LAYHE WA A’LAYHEMUS SALAAM) WA QENEE SHARRAHU WAK FENEE AMRAHU WAS RIF A’NNEE KAYDAHU WA AHRIJ QALBAHU WA SUDDA FAAHO A’NNEE “WA KHASHA-A’TIL ASWAATO LIR-RAHMAANE FALAA TASMA-O’ ILLAA HAMSAA” “WA A’NATIL WOJOOHO LIL-HAYYIL QAYYOOME WA QAD KHAABA MAN HAMALA ZULMAA” “IKHSA-OO FEEHAA WA LAA TOKALLEMOON” SAH SAH SAH SAH SAH SAH SAH.

trans.en: O Allah! Embed him in misfortune, and cover him in calamity, and indulge him in discomfort and harassment one after the other, and involve him daily that he cannot escape [it should be continuous], and hourly that he cannot escape, and expose his sanctity, and send blessings upon Muhammad and his household (peace be upon him and them), and protect me from his evil, and save me from his commands, and force his heart in awkward situation, and keep his mouth shut on me. “and the voices shall be low before the Beneficent Allah so that you shall not hear aught but a soft sound.” “And the faces shall be humbled before the Living, the Self-subsistent Allah, and he who bears iniquity is indeed a failure.” “Go away into it and speak not to Me.” Be silent, be silent, be silent, be silent, be silent, be silent, be silent.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
